person.org: P contacts are listed on the org, but their gifts, meetings and hours do not roll up to it
person.srch: P name and email only; phone, contact name and household are not searched
person.jc: P a Group can feed a Journey, but the Communications builder has no way to pick a Group (SEG_MODES has no audience mode and openBuilder drops audienceId)
person.mrg: P merge leaves calendar meetings (calendar_events.person_ids), agent_writes and custom_field_events on the merged-away id; bulk delete writes no Undo row; /tasks still lists a deleted person's tasks
person.ask: P Ask refuses 'what has [name] done with us this year?' (no activity answer about one person); people entity has no kind or person_types

household.tl: M joining or leaving a household writes nothing on the timeline
household.srch: M household names are not searched
household.jc: M no household audience or trigger
household.rep: M household total renders bare on the profile, no figure source
household.ask: P the Agent can add to a household; Ask has no household entity
household.io: P import stamps external_household_id but never creates a households row

organization / funder.tl: P the funder record shows its own rows and the grants panel, never its contacts' activity or the gifts it matched
organization / funder.grp: M no rule for kind = organization or funder of a grant
organization / funder.jc: M no audience for organizations or funders
organization / funder.rep: P funder grant figures only; no organisations figure
organization / funder.ask: P Ask cannot tell an organisation from a person

gift.org: P an employer never sees the gifts it matched (gifts.match_employer_id)
gift.home: P a Thank step opens for manual and Stripe gifts only, not for tickets, auction payments or synced sources; the giving-source 'gone quiet' task never opens (queries tasks.completed/due_date, columns that do not exist)
gift.mrg: P purge-trash leaves fin_transactions and other donors' tribute/match pointers
gift.io: P /gifts/import-history writes no import_id or payment_method, so Undo import cannot reach those gifts and the bookkeeper file's method is blank

recurring plan.tl: P starting a plan writes no line; each charge shows as a gift
recurring plan.cal: M next charge date is not on the calendar
recurring plan.grp: P only 'monthly'; no any-interval or failed rule; two definitions of 'has recurring' (groups.js vs journey audience)
recurring plan.jc: P first_recurring triggers; failed or cancelled does not
recurring plan.mrg: P soft delete does not stop the Stripe plan; purge leaves recurring_proposals and recurring_change_log
recurring plan.ask: P Ask yes; the Agent cannot see plans
recurring plan.io: P an imported sustainer is a flag, not a plan, so it is missing from recurring figures and Ask

pledge.tl: P creating a pledge writes no line; only reminders do
pledge.ask: P only the outstanding metric; no pledges entity; the Agent cannot see pledges

campaign.cal: P sends are on it; campaign start and end dates are not
campaign.jc: P only as a gift-trigger filter; a campaign's donors are not an audience
campaign.mrg: P purge leaves sequence_sends and reconnect_sends
campaign.ask: P entity amount is the goal only; the Agent cannot see campaigns
campaign.io: P imported gifts carry the campaign name only, so Reports filtered by campaign (id match) miss them

appeal.tl: P attribution shows only as text on the gift

giving page.tl: P the gift shows; nothing page-specific
giving page.cal: M giving_pages.ends_on is not on the calendar
giving page.rep: M raised on a giving page has no figure source
giving page.ask: M neither Ask nor the Agent can see giving pages

peer-to-peer page.tl: M creating a fundraiser page writes nothing on the fundraiser's timeline
peer-to-peer page.cal: M page end date not on the calendar
peer-to-peer page.srch: P a 'Go to' shortcut only; pages are not searchable
peer-to-peer page.home: M a page waiting for approval opens no step
peer-to-peer page.ask: M neither Ask nor the Agent can see peer-to-peer pages

event and ticket.tl: P paid tickets show; a free RSVP writes nothing and door check-in writes no 'Came to' line
event and ticket.cal: P on Steward's calendar; never pushed to Google or Outlook (no owner)
event and ticket.grp: P gaveEvent counts ticket gifts; no attended or registered rule; guests cannot be saved as a Group
event and ticket.jc: P attended_event fires from the attendance list only, not from check-in or scan; no event's-guests audience
event and ticket.rep: P event rows open through a private endpoint, not the figure registry
event and ticket.io: P no attendee import and no guest CSV export

auction item.tl: P donated items and paid wins show; bids write nothing
auction item.cal: M auction close is not on the calendar
auction item.home: M won but not paid opens no step
auction item.mrg: P purge leaves auction_bidders, auction_items, auction_refund_flags
auction item.ask: M neither Ask nor the Agent can see auctions
auction item.io: P no import; JSON export only

membership.tl: P shows only when paid; a comp join or a cancel writes nothing
membership.cal: M memberships expiring are not on the calendar
membership.grp: M no member-level or member-status rule
membership.jc: P became_member triggers; lapsed does not; no Communications audience
membership.home: P expiring opens a renewal step; lapsed does not
membership.mrg: P a member blocks purge-trash (FK with no cascade, not in CHILD_TABLES)
membership.rep: P status counts render bare; member reports return no sources
membership.ask: P Ask yes (no money); the Agent cannot see memberships
membership.io: P imported members carry no money, so they are absent from membership revenue

grant.tl: P only grant emails reach the funder; stage changes, the award and grant notes (grant_interactions) do not
grant.cal: P milestones are on it; a report with its own due date and no milestone is not
grant.home: P raised at lead time, but skipped when the grant has no funder record and for reports with no milestone
grant.ask: P Ask yes; the Agent cannot see grants
grant.io: P grant import drops decision date and report due, and stamps awarded_at = now, so old awards count as this year's

volunteer shift and hours.rep: P a coordinator gets 403 on /figures, so their hour figures cannot open

journey step.cal: P each open journey step shows twice (journey + the Thread step it opened), and is pushed twice
journey step.rep: P journey rows open through a private endpoint
journey step.ask: P the Agent can start or stop one; Ask has no journey entity

task / next step.tl: P tasks show; an open Thread step does not, and a dismissal writes nothing
task / next step.cal: P on it; pushed only when assigned, and auto steps often have no owner
task / next step.mrg: P /tasks still lists a deleted person's tasks
task / next step.rep: P next steps closed has a source; tasks have none

meeting.mrg: M merge does not move calendar_events.person_ids, so the meetings vanish from the kept person
meeting.ask: P Ask conversations leave out calendar meetings, which the meetings figure counts
meeting.io: P calendar_events is not in the CSV export

email.grp: M no opened or clicked rule
email.home: M a donor's email that needs a reply opens no step
email.rep: P bulk email stats are computed in the browser or bare

document.tl: P attachments show; grant documents only on the funder panel; receipt PDFs never
document.io: P stored files are left out of the export (by design, the export is data)

import.tl: P imported rows show; the import itself is never an item
import.home: M new duplicates from an import open no step (counted, never shown)
import.rep: P import health and the move report are bespoke, no figure sources

report.ask: P Ask answers open; stored board reports never reach Ask
